description: Agent Uncertainty: submit the uncertainty report written for the principal, with the record behind it: its title, its audience, the answer as the report states it and optionally its text, read for certainty wording such as beyond doubt or definitely; whether it states what is known, what is unknown, what is assumed, what is contested and the evidence that would change the answer, where each sits (beside the answer, in a later section, in an appendix or in a separate document) and how many of each it names; whether the uncertainty sits apart from the answer rather than woven through it; and optionally the record of established points, open unknowns, assumptions, contested points and evidence that would change the answer. The signed report gives the report with any certainty wording, the disclosure of each kind of uncertainty with its placement and count and whether it sits apart from the answer, and the record, and names a report that conceals the uncertainty behind the answer: unknowns left out or stated as none while the record holds some, assumptions left out, contested points left out, and uncertainty woven through the answer so the principal cannot tell the answer from what qualifies it; then what is known or what would change the answer left out, counts below the record’s, unknowns, assumptions or contested points in an appendix or a separate document, and certainty wording while the record holds unknowns or contested points, with the fix for each. What a knowledge base holds and lacks across topics is wever_knowledge-report-check, an evaluation summary of scores is wever_evaluation-report-check, an observability summary is wever_observability-report-check, and a feedback summary is wever_feedback-report-check. Verdict uncertainty_concealed, uncertainty_report_gaps, uncertainty_report_unverified or uncertainty_report_sound. POST /api/uncertainty-report-check. Reads only the recorded work product and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no answer is changed, no source is fetched and no party is contacted. Agent Uncertainty reads the uncertainty an agent carries in its own work products and answers, its stated confidence, what it does not know and what it assumed: it is not formal scoring of outputs against rubrics, datasets and benchmarks (the wever_evaluation checks), not grading the source material itself (wever_claim-evidence-check, wever_data-evidence-check and the other evidence checks), not traces, metrics and runtime behavior (the wever_observability checks) and not the loop around feedback received (the wever_feedback checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-uncertainty-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-uncertainty/.
